tokens.name: olive-700

tokens.name: olive-600
tokens.usage: Backs brand-accent. The dark value was deepened from the source's #b6d7a8 so the accent stays a distinct olive instead of collapsing into action-primary's sage.

tokens.name: olive-500

tokens.name: sage-300

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Body background. Everything else sits above it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and control fills.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Identity card and checked theme-choice — a warmer step than surface-raised.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Disabled control fill.

tokens.name: surface-avatar
tokens.usage: Initials-avatar circle fill. Pairs with on-surface-avatar (5.79:1 light, 7.66:1 dark).

tokens.name: surface-badge
tokens.usage: Draft-status pill fill. Carries text-primary at 10.86:1 light, 9.95:1 dark.

tokens.name: surface-success
tokens.usage: Success notice fill. Pairs with on-surface-success (7.20:1 light, 8.89:1 dark).

tokens.name: surface-error
tokens.usage: Error notice fill. Pairs with on-surface-error (8.10:1 light, 9.20:1 dark).

tokens.name: surface-reconcile
tokens.usage: Reconcile panel fill — a server/draft conflict. Deliberately neither the error nor the success tint: it's a decision, not a fault. Carries text-primary at 10.90:1 light, 10.19:1 dark.

tokens.name: surface-scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer behind a dialog. Never a ground for text.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on surface-page, surface-raised, surface-tint, surface-badge and surface-reconcile — 10.4:1 or better on each, in both themes.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Ledes, eyebrows, help text, footer copy. On surface-page 5.10:1 light / 9.20:1 dark; on surface-raised 5.50:1 / 8.08:1; on surface-tint 4.87:1 / 7.00:1.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Text inside a disabled control, on surface-sunken (4.50:1 light, 5.70:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Anchor text, secondary-button label, text-button label, and the border of an input while it has focus. On surface-page 8.87:1 light / 10.62:1 dark; on the secondary-button fill 9.11:1 / 7.60:1.

tokens.name: on-action-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action-primary (9.60:1 light, 9.90:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-surface-avatar
tokens.usage: Initials on surface-avatar.

tokens.name: on-surface-success
tokens.usage: Text on surface-success.

tokens.name: on-surface-error
tokens.usage: Text on surface-error.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines — card edges, header and footer rules, table dividers. Deliberately near-invisible (1.22:1 light, 2.23:1 dark): separation here is a whisper, and nothing that carries meaning may rely on it alone.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: The resting boundary of every control — inputs, textareas, selects and secondary buttons. Darkened in light mode from the source's #b9c6b9 (1.76:1) to clear the 3:1 non-text floor: now 3.52:1 on surface-page, 3.80:1 on surface-raised, 3.62:1 on the secondary-button fill. Dark mode keeps the source value (3.89:1 / 4.43:1).

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Control border under the pointer — one visible step darker than border-control in light mode, one step lighter in dark. Focus moves it again, to text-link.

tokens.name: border-badge
tokens.usage: Draft-pill border. Decorative: the pill's fill and text carry its meaning.

tokens.name: border-success
tokens.usage: Success notice border. Decorative reinforcement of the fill.

tokens.name: border-error
tokens.usage: Error notice border. Decorative reinforcement of the fill.

tokens.name: border-reconcile
tokens.usage: Reconcile panel border. Decorative reinforcement of the fill.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill; also the brand-mark circle and the skip link.

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: action-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill. In light mode it sits within 1.02:1 of surface-page on purpose — border-control is what makes the button a button, which is why that token must hold 3:1.

tokens.name: action-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: action-text-hover
tokens.usage: Text-button fill under the pointer — the only fill a text button ever takes.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Field-error text and the border of an invalid control. On surface-raised 7.80:1 light, 9.00:1 dark.

tokens.name: status-pending
tokens.usage: The loading dot, for anything in flight. Darkened in light mode from the source's #8c9c64 (2.73:1) so the mark itself clears 3:1 — 3.23:1 on surface-page, 3.48:1 on surface-raised — rather than leaning on the sentence beside it.

tokens.name: ring-focus
tokens.usage: Outer half of the focus ring, 3px at 3px offset. Reads 3.09–3.49:1 across light-mode grounds — passing but without margin, which is why ring-focus-inner sits inside it.

tokens.name: ring-focus-inner
tokens.usage: Inner half of the focus ring, 3px hugging the element. A dark ink in both themes, so the ring stays legible whatever it lands on: 3.47:1 against the outer olive in light, 11.83:1 in dark, and always high against a pale control fill.

tokens.name: brand-accent
tokens.usage: The wordmark's full stop and the principle-card glyphs. Never an interactive state. The dark value is a deeper olive than the source's, so accent and action stay distinguishable in dark mode.

tokens.usage: Существующее значение интерфейса; перенесено в единый источник в MM-87 без смены палитры.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The page h1, one per page, always a full sentence with a period. Mobile fixed at 3.1rem. The only serif moment on a screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section and card titles that need presence without becoming the page h1. Added to fill the gap between heading and display — the source jumped straight from 24.8px to 45px, so card headings had been borrowing h2 at an ad-hoc 1.35rem.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Вход выполнен. Нам нужно немного времени.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Небольшие детали, из которых складывается знакомство.
styles.usage: Intro copy under a heading. Same size as body — what makes it a lede is text-secondary, the looser leading and a measure capped near 52ch.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and h4. Merges the source's two near-identical steps (0.82rem labels, 0.9rem h4).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Field help text and masthead meta.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section kicker above a heading, in text-secondary. Raised from the source's 0.65rem: at uppercase with this tracking, 10.4px was the smallest thing on the page.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Section numbers and field counters. Same size as caption; tabular numerals and wider tracking are what set it apart.
